faq.q: Are there market statistics for Langley mobile homes under $500k?
faq.a: No manufactured-home statistics are published in the SnapStats report — it has no manufactured-home category. The only SnapStats figures for Langley are all-residential community context, as of September 2026: Detached median $1,345,000 (449 active, 64 sold) and Condos & Townhomes median $611,000 (699 active, 128 sold) — neither describes this page's manufactured-home shelf (community-stats-sep2026.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Do I own the land under a mobile home in Cheap Langley?
faq.a: Usually not. In most parks you own the home and pay monthly pad rent to the park owner, and the tenancy falls under BC's Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act. Ask for the tenancy agreement, the current pad rent and the park rules before you make an offer.

faq.q: Can I get a mortgage on a mobile home in Cheap Langley?
faq.a: Lenders look at the age of the home, whether it carries a CSA certification label and the terms of the pad tenancy, and some will not finance older homes. Speak to a mortgage broker before you write an offer, not after.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Cheap Langley?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
